summary: First testing pass on WorkSheet MVP (spreadsheet-first work tracker). Executed 20 pytest backend tests covering users, options, work-items CRUD, role-based permissions and filters — ALL 20 PASSED. Executed comprehensive Playwright UI tests covering role switcher (6 seeded users grouped by role), localStorage persistence across reload, admin add/edit/delete, manager edit (no delete), member row visibility (creator-only), member read-only cells + disabled Closed/Changes Requested status options, and toolbar filters/clear. ALL UI EXPECTATIONS MET.

issues: Row-count badge (myRowsCount) is hidden on md- viewports (hidden md:inline). Minor — acceptable for MVP.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: startup seed_users uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event; consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).

UserContext: localStorage is only written when user changes the value via Select; initial default (data[0].id) isn't persisted. Not a functional bug because reload uses the same fallback, but consider persisting default to keep behavior explicit.
WorkSheetRow: `Textarea` for remarks is rows=1 with min-h — good; ensure long content wraps rather than causing horizontal overflow.
server.py: PATCH silently drops disallowed fields for members (deliverable_name etc). Consider returning 400/403 instead of silent noop for better UX/API contract.
No pagination on GET /api/work-items (to_list(5000)). Fine for MVP; add pagination when scale grows.
test_credentials: None required. Backend uses X-User-Id header. Seeded IDs: admin-1, manager-1, manager-2, member-1, member-2, member-3.
seed_data_creation: Startup seeds 6 users. Tests create rows with TEST_ prefix and clean up via fixture teardown or explicit admin delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_worksheet.py (pytest, 20 tests). Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_worksheet.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. All permission enforcement (member cannot set Closed/Changes Requested, member cannot edit others, member cannot delete, manager cannot delete, member sees only own rows) is covered. Frontend role-based rendering verified: member has read-only deliverable/type/category/creator/reviewer cells and no delete button, manager has all edit inputs but no delete button, admin has full access including delete. localStorage persistence of acting_user_id verified across reload.
